{{Infobox auto|Brown Mushroom}}

'''Mushrooms''' come in two kinds with different roles in [[cooking]]. The '''red mushroom''', called a toadstool in food names, is an [[ingredient]] whose [[intrinsic]] is {{EffectLink|Poison}}. The '''brown mushroom''' has no intrinsic and is the pack's pickling agent: every pickle and several other preserves need one.

== Obtaining ==

Mushrooms are found and farmed as in vanilla. A brown or red mushroom block can be crafted into 1 mushroom.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/brown_mushroom_from_mushroom_block.json}}</ref>

{{Recipes|Brown Mushroom}}
{{Recipes|Red Mushroom}}

== Usage ==

=== Brown mushroom ===
Brown mushrooms are cooked into [[braised mushroom]]s, which make [[pickled mushrooms]] and [[stroganoff]] and top [[mushroom pizza]]. Raw brown mushrooms are the preservative in [[pickled carrots]], [[pickled potatoes]], [[sun-dried tomatoes]], [[pickled toadstools]], [[golden pickled carrots]], [[pickled crimson fungus]] and [[pickled warped fungus]], and are also used in [[cheese]], [[mead]] and [[ramen stock]].

{{Uses|Brown Mushroom}}

=== Red mushroom ===
Red mushrooms are cooked into [[braised toadstool]]s (Poison, 0:30), pickled into [[pickled toadstools]] (a splash potion of Poison II, 1:00) and cooked into [[toadstool stroganoff]] (Poison, 5:00). These foods poison the player who eats them; the pickle can be thrown at mobs.

{{Uses|Red Mushroom}}
